title: Cancellation races with late child completion
description: Child reserves 20 units. Parent cancels the task and releases capacity, but the child later reports 8 units of actual work.
expected_invariants: Late usage and cancellation/release are reconciled without silently making budget availability inconsistent.
failure_mode: Released reservation is reused while late usage is also committed, exceeding capacity.
notes: Cancellation semantics must be explicitly defined.
